rules: BUKLOD Main is the root hub, not the deployment host for standalone Focus Apps.
A door in BUKLOD Main does not transfer repository, Expo project, database, hosting, or release ownership to BUKLOD Main.
Standalone Focus Apps require their own explicitly registered repository and production target before production deployment.
If a standalone Focus App has no dedicated target registered here, production deployment must stop. Never fall back to BUKLOD Main.
Main-side Focus App workflows may perform source checks, tests, and integration QA, but must not perform a standalone Focus App production release.
No app identity may be inferred from the current conversation topic, nearby source files, route names, or an existing Expo token. The registered app identity is authoritative.
